```text
2	# Parses ~/.config/docs/tools/cli-tools.md at runtime — single source of truth.
3	#
4	# Usage:

6	#   prefix + U in tmux                     (popup)
7	#   Alt+T in zsh                           (opens fzf ZLE variant instead)

47	mode = "execute"
```

```text
3:[television](https://github.com/alexpasmantier/television) — blazing-fast TUI fuzzy finder with pluggable "channels".
5:Custom channels: `dot_config/television/cable/` (chezmoi-managed)
12:tv                   # Open interactive picker (default channel)
13:tv <channel>         # Open a specific channel, e.g. tv sesh
14:tv list-channels     # List all available channels
18:From tmux: `prefix + T` opens the sesh channel as a popup (see [Tmux Integration](#tmux-integration)).
24:tv has a built-in channel package manager. Run once after install (and periodically to update):
27:tv update-channels
30:This downloads [community-maintained channels](https://alexpasmantier.github.io/television/community/channels-unix) into `~/.config/television/cable/`. It:
32:- **Skips** channels whose requirements aren't met on your system (e.g. `apt-packages` on macOS)
33:- **Skips** channels that already exist (won't overwrite custom channels)
36:Notable community channels: `sesh`, `git-branch`, `git-log`, `git-stash`, `git-diff`, `brew-packages`, `docker-containers`, `gh-issues`, `gh-prs`, `just-recipes`, `zoxide`, `zsh-history`, `env`, `dirs`, `files`, `text`.
42:### `tools` channel
57:### `lan-devices` channel
59:Fuzzy-search devices on the local subnet with open ports, MAC/vendor, hostname (rDNS + mDNS), ping RTT, and last-seen timestamp. Backed by `~/.config/television/lan-scan.sh`, which writes results incrementally to `~/.cache/tv/lan-devices.tsv` and per-host nmap detail to `~/.cache/tv/lan-ports/<ip>.txt`. The channel uses `watch = 2.0`, so rows stream into the picker as the background scan progresses (state column: `discovered` → `scanning` → `scanned`).
106:### `pueue` channel
150:`Alt+G` extracts the group name from the selected entry and launches a new `tv` instance with `--source-command` filtered to that group. The filtered view has preview but not the full action keybindings. Quit to return to the main `tv pueue` channel. Enter on the groups source (cycle 4) shows a quick text overview via `pueue status -g`.
162:- `Ctrl+Y` is overridden in the pueue channel to copy just the raw command (TV's default `ctrl-y` copies the full display line including ID, status, and group)
167:### `sesh` channel (community)
169:Provided by `tv update-channels`. Source cycling through session types and directory search, with connect/kill actions.
```

```md
# Plan: `ansible` TV channel

## Context

This dotfiles repo manages its system setup through ansible playbooks in `dot_ansible/`
(3 playbooks, 18 roles). Today, browsing them or running syntax checks / playbook
commands means typing long paths from memory (e.g.
`ANSIBLE_CONFIG=dot_ansible/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook --syntax-check ...`).

Several TV channels already exist under `dot_config/television/cable/` (pueue, tools,
lan-devices, ports, kill-process, ssh-config, aliases, channels) that offer fuzzy
search + previews + action keybindings. A channel for ansible would give the user:

- fuzzy-search across playbooks / roles / tags with inline preview
- one-key actions to `ansible-playbook` run, dry-run, syntax-check
- copy-to-clipboard of the full command for pasting into a terminal
- open-in-editor for quick role/task edits

## Recommended approach

Add a single channel file `dot_config/television/cable/ansible.toml` with three
cyclable sources (Ctrl+S):

1. **Playbooks** — `~/.ansible/playbooks/*.yml`
2. **Roles** — directory listing of `~/.ansible/roles/*/`
3. **Tags** — extracted from `playbooks/*.yml` via `grep -hoE 'tags: \[[^]]+\]'`
   (playbooks use flat `tags: [name]` form, see `dot_ansible/playbooks/macos.yml`)

Display format is TSV with leading `kind` column (`playbook` / `role` / `tag`) so
actions can dispatch by type using `{split:\t:0}`.

### Preview

- playbook → `bat --color=always -l yaml ~/.ansible/playbooks/<name>.yml`
- role → `bat` of `~/.ansible/roles/<name>/tasks/main.yml`, with `defaults/main.yml`
  appended if present
- tag → `grep -rn "tags: \[.*<tag>.*\]" ~/.ansible/playbooks/` so user can see
  which playbook(s) use it

### Keybindings (Alt+* to avoid tmux / TV-builtin clashes)

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| Enter | Run: `ansible-playbook <playbook>` (foreground, `mode = "execute"`) |
| Alt+C | Syntax check: `ansible-playbook --syntax-check ...` |
| Alt+D | Dry run: `ansible-playbook --check ...` |
| Alt+T | Run a playbook **filtered by the current tag** (prompts which playbook if source is tag) |
| Alt+E | Open selected file in `$EDITOR` (playbook file, or role's `tasks/main.yml`) |
| Alt+V | Open the role directory in `yazi` (roles source only) |
| Ctrl+Y / Alt+Y | Copy the full `ansible-playbook ...` command to clipboard (reuse the `_clip()` helper pattern from `pueue.toml` for OSC 52 over SSH) |
| Ctrl+F | Cycle preview (main → defaults for roles; file → matching-lines for tags) |
| Ctrl+O | Toggle preview panel |
```

```text
## Approved Plan:
# Plan: `ansible` TV channel

## Context

This dotfiles repo manages its system setup through ansible playbooks in `dot_ansible/`
(3 playbooks, 18 roles). Today, browsing them or running syntax checks / playbook
commands means typing long paths from memory (e.g.
`ANSIBLE_CONFIG=dot_ansible/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook --syntax-check ...`).

Several TV channels already exist under `dot_config/television/cable/` (pueue, tools,
lan-devices, ports, kill-process, ssh-config, aliases, channels) that offer fuzzy
search + previews + action keybindings. A channel for ansible would give the user:

- fuzzy-search across playbooks / roles / tags with inline preview
- one-key actions to `ansible-playbook` run, dry-run, syntax-check
- copy-to-clipboard of the full command for pasting into a terminal
- open-in-editor for quick role/task edits

## Recommended approach

Add a single channel file `dot_config/television/cable/ansible.toml` with three
cyclable sources (Ctrl+S):

1. **Playbooks** — `~/.ansible/playbooks/*.yml`
2. **Roles** — directory listing of `~/.ansible/roles/*/`
3. **Tags** — extracted from `playbooks/*.yml` via `grep -hoE 'tags: \[[^]]+\]'`
   (playbooks use flat `tags: [name]` form, see `dot_ansible/playbooks/macos.yml`)

Display format is TSV with leading `kind` column (`playbook` / `role` / `tag`) so
actions can dispatch by type using `{split:\t:0}`.

### Preview

- playbook → `bat --color=always -l yaml ~/.ansible/playbooks/<name>.yml`
- role → `bat` of `~/.ansible/roles/<name>/tasks/main.yml`, with `defaults/main.yml`
  appended if present
- tag → `grep -rn "tags: \[.*<tag>.*\]" ~/.ansible/playbooks/` so user can see
  which playbook(s) use it

### Keybindings (Alt+* to avoid tmux / TV-builtin clashes)

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| Enter | Run: `ansible-playbook <playbook>` (foreground, `mode = "execute"`) |
| Alt+C | Syntax check: `ansible-playbook --syntax-check ...` |
| Alt+D | Dry run: `ansible-playbook --check ...` |
| Alt+T | Run a playbook **filtered by the current tag** (prompts which playbook if source is tag) |
| Alt+E | Open selected file in `$EDITOR` (playbook file, or role's `tasks/main.yml`) |
| Alt+V | Open the role directory in `yazi` (roles source only) |
| Ctrl+Y / Alt+Y | Copy the full `ansible-playbook ...` command to clipboard (reuse the `_clip()` helper pattern from `pueue.toml` for OSC 52 over SSH) |
| Ctrl+F | Cycle preview (main → defaults for roles; file → matching-lines for tags) |
| Ctrl+O | Toggle preview panel |

All commands use `ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg` and `cd ~/.ansible`
so they match the manual invocation pattern documented in `CLAUDE.md`.
OS-appropriate playbook default: detect via `uname` in a small shell snippet —
tag actions default to `macos.yml` on Darwin, `linux.yml` otherwise.

## Files to modify

- **Create** `dot_config/television/cable/ansible.toml` — the channel (model after
  `dot_config/television/cable/pueue.toml:31-129` for metadata, sources, actions,
  and the `_clip` OSC-52 helper)
- **Update** `docs/tools/tv.md` — add an `### \`ansible\` channel` section
  alongside the existing `tools`, `lan-devices`, `pueue` sections (around
  `docs/tools/tv.md:42-167`)
- **Update** `README.md` — only if the channel belongs in the user-facing config
  file list; otherwise leave README alone since per-channel detail lives in
  `docs/tools/tv.md`

No changes needed to the `channels` meta-channel (`channels.toml`) — it auto-picks
up any new `*.toml` in the cable dir.
```

```toml
# Ansible channel for television (tv)
# Browse playbooks, roles, and tags under ~/.ansible/ with inline preview and
# one-key actions for run / syntax-check / dry-run / copy-command.
#
# Usage:
#   tv ansible
#
# Source cycling (Ctrl+S):
#   1. Playbooks  (~/.ansible/playbooks/*.yml)
#   2. Roles      (~/.ansible/roles/*/)
#   3. Tags       (extracted from playbooks)
#
# Keybindings:
#   Enter      Run playbook (or run the role's default OS playbook filtered by role-as-tag)
#   Alt+C      Syntax check
#   Alt+D      Dry run (--check)
#   Alt+T      Run OS-default playbook filtered by selected tag/role
#   Alt+E      Edit selected file in $EDITOR
#   Alt+V      Open role directory in yazi (roles only)
#   Ctrl+Y     Copy full ansible-playbook command to clipboard (overrides TV default)
#   Alt+Y      Copy full ansible-playbook command to clipboard
#   Ctrl+F     Cycle preview
#   Ctrl+O     Toggle preview panel
#
# All actions cd into ~/.ansible and use ANSIBLE_CONFIG=~/.ansible/ansible.cfg.
# OS default: macos.yml on Darwin, linux.yml otherwise.

[metadata]
name = "ansible"
description = "Ansible playbooks / roles / tags: browse, syntax-check, run, copy command"
requirements = ["ansible-playbook"]

[source]
command = [
  """find ~/.ansible/playbooks -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.yml' 2>/dev/null | sort | awk -F/ '{name=$NF; sub(/\\.yml$/,"",name); printf "playbook\\t%s\\t%s\\n", name, $0}'""",
  """find ~/.ansible/roles -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort | awk -F/ '{printf "role\\t%s\\t%s\\n", $NF, $0}'""",
  """grep -hoE 'tags: \\[[^]]+\\]' ~/.ansible/playbooks/*.yml 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/tags: \\[//; s/\\]//; s/,/\\n/g' | tr -d ' ' | sort -u | awk 'NF{printf "tag\\t%s\\t-\\n", $0}'""",
]
display = "{split:\\t:0}  {split:\\t:1}"
output = "{split:\\t:1}"
no_sort = true

[preview]
command = [
  """kind='{split:\\t:0}'; name='{split:\\t:1}'; path='{split:\\t:2}'; case "$kind" in
  playbook) bat --color=always -l yaml --style=numbers "$path" 2>/dev/null || cat "$path" ;;
  role) main="$path/tasks/main.yml"; defs="$path/defaults/main.yml"; if [ -f "$main" ]; then echo "=== tasks/main.yml ==="; bat --color=always -l yaml --style=numbers "$main" 2>/dev/null || cat "$main"; fi; if [ -f "$defs" ]; then echo; echo "=== defaults/main.yml ==="; bat --color=always -l yaml --style=numbers "$defs" 2>/dev/null || cat "$defs"; fi ;;
  tag) grep -rn --color=always "tags: \\[.*\\b${name}\\b.*\\]" ~/.ansible/playbooks/ 2>/dev/null ;;
  esac""",
  """kind='{split:\\t:0}'; name='{split:\\t:1}'; path='{split:\\t:2}'; case "$kind" in
  playbook) grep -hoE 'tags: \\[[^]]+\\]' "$path" | sed -E 's/tags: \\[//; s/\\]//; s/,/\\n/g' | tr -d ' ' | sort -u ;;
  role) ls -la "$path" ;;
  tag) grep -rln --color=always "tags: \\[.*\\b${name}\\b.*\\]" ~/.ansible/roles/ 2>/dev/null | head -40 ;;
  esac""",
]
header = "{split:\\t:0}: {split:\\t:1}"

[ui]
input_header = "Ansible"

[ui.preview_panel]
size = 55

[keybindings]
enter = "actions:run"
alt-c = "actions:syntax_check"
alt-d = "actions:check"
alt-t = "actions:run_tag"
alt-e = "actions:edit"
alt-v = "actions:yazi"
ctrl-y = "actions:copy_cmd"
alt-y = "actions:copy_cmd"

[actions.run]
description = "Run playbook (or OS-default playbook filtered by role/tag)"
command = """kind='{split:\\t:0}'; name='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; cd ~/.ansible || exit 1; export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg; case "$kind" in
  playbook) ansible-playbook "playbooks/${name}.yml" ;;
  role|tag) ansible-playbook "playbooks/${pb}" --tags "$name" ;;
esac; echo; echo '[Press Enter to exit]'; read -r _"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.syntax_check]
description = "Syntax check"
command = """kind='{split:\\t:0}'; name='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; cd ~/.ansible || exit 1; export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg; case "$kind" in
  playbook) ansible-playbook --syntax-check "playbooks/${name}.yml" ;;
  role|tag) ansible-playbook --syntax-check "playbooks/${pb}" --tags "$name" ;;
esac; echo; echo '[Press Enter to exit]'; read -r _"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.check]
description = "Dry run (--check)"
command = """kind='{split:\\t:0}'; name='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; cd ~/.ansible || exit 1; export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg; case "$kind" in
  playbook) ansible-playbook --check "playbooks/${name}.yml" ;;
  role|tag) ansible-playbook --check "playbooks/${pb}" --tags "$name" ;;
esac; echo; echo '[Press Enter to exit]'; read -r _"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.run_tag]
description = "Run OS-default playbook filtered by selected tag/role name"
command = """name='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; cd ~/.ansible || exit 1; export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg; ansible-playbook "playbooks/${pb}" --tags "$name"; echo; echo '[Press Enter to exit]'; read -r _"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.edit]
description = "Edit selected file (playbook YAML or role's tasks/main.yml)"
command = """kind='{split:\\t:0}'; path='{split:\\t:2}'; case "$kind" in
  playbook) ${EDITOR:-vi} "$path" ;;
  role) ${EDITOR:-vi} "$path/tasks/main.yml" ;;
  tag) ${EDITOR:-vi} ~/.ansible/playbooks ;;
esac"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.yazi]
description = "Open role directory in yazi"
command = """kind='{split:\\t:0}'; path='{split:\\t:2}'; if [ "$kind" = "role" ] && command -v yazi >/dev/null 2>&1; then yazi "$path"; else echo 'yazi action only valid on roles'; sleep 1; fi"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.copy_cmd]
description = "Copy full ansible-playbook command to clipboard"
command = """_clip() { local d; d=$(cat); [ -z "$d" ] && return; if command -v pbcopy >/dev/null; then printf '%s' "$d" | pbcopy; elif command -v wl-copy >/dev/null; then printf '%s' "$d" | wl-copy; elif command -v xclip >/dev/null; then printf '%s' "$d" | xclip -selection clipboard; else printf '%b' "\\033]52;c;$(printf '%s' "$d" | base64)\\007" > /dev/tty; fi; }; kind='{split:\\t:0}'; name='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; case "$kind" in
  playbook) printf 'cd ~/.ansible && ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook playbooks/%s.yml' "$name" | _clip ;;
  role|tag) printf 'cd ~/.ansible && ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook playbooks/%s --tags %s' "$pb" "$name" | _clip ;;
esac"""
mode = "fork"

```


40	## Custom Channels
41	
42	### `tools` channel
43	
44	Parses `~/.config/docs/tools/cli-tools.md` at runtime (deployed via chezmoi from `dot_config/docs/tools/`). The markdown file is the single source of truth — edit it to add or update tools.
45	
46	Open with `tv tools` or `prefix + U` in tmux.
47	
48	| Key | Action |
49	|-----|--------|
50	| `Enter` | Execute selected tool immediately |
51	| `Ctrl+/` | Toggle preview panel (tldr or `--help`) |
52	
53	For pasting an invocation to the shell buffer (with trailing space for tools that need arguments), use the fzf ZLE widget instead: **Alt+T** in any zsh session.
54	
55	---
56	
57	### `lan-devices` channel
58	
59	Fuzzy-search devices on the local subnet with open ports, MAC/vendor, hostname (rDNS + mDNS), ping RTT, and last-seen timestamp. Backed by `~/.config/television/lan-scan.sh`, which writes results incrementally to `~/.cache/tv/lan-devices.tsv` and per-host nmap detail to `~/.cache/tv/lan-ports/<ip>.txt`. The channel uses `watch = 2.0`, so rows stream into the picker as the background scan progresses (state column: `discovered` → `scanning` → `scanned`).
60	
61	Open with `tv lan-devices`, or run a synchronous scan first with the `lanscan` shell alias.
62	
63	**Sudo-gated with fallback:** when passwordless sudo is available (`sudo -n true`), the script uses `arp-scan -lgq` for the richest MAC/vendor data. Otherwise it falls back to `nmap -sn` ping sweep + OS ARP cache (`arp -an` on macOS, `ip neigh` on Linux). Vendor lookup for the fallback path uses nmap's `nmap-mac-prefixes` OUI database.
64	
65	**Source cycling** (`Ctrl+S`):
66	
67	| Source | Description |
68	|--------|-------------|
69	| All devices | Every discovered host, sorted by IP (default) |
70	| With open ports | Only rows whose port count is ≥ 1 |
71	| Fresh only | Hosts seen within the last 5 minutes |
72	
73	**Preview cycling** (`Ctrl+F`):
74	
75	1. Cached nmap service detail (fast, from `~/.cache/tv/lan-ports/<ip>.txt`)
76	2. Live `nmap -sV -Pn -F` rescan (blocking, ~10–30 s)
77	3. ARP + rDNS + mDNS + ping metadata
78	
79	**Keybindings** (`Alt+` namespace avoids tmux/TV conflicts):
80	
81	| Key | Action |
82	|-----|--------|
83	| `Enter` | Full `nmap -sV -A` in execute mode |
84	| `Alt+R` | Rescan ports on selected host + reload |
85	| `Alt+F` | Rescan full subnet (discover + ports) + reload |
86	| `Alt+D` | Re-discover only (no port scan) + reload |
87	| `Alt+S` | SSH to selected host |
88	| `Alt+H` | Open `http://<ip>` in the system browser |
89	| `Alt+C` | Clear scan cache + reload |
90	| `Ctrl+Y` | Copy IP to clipboard (OSC 52 over SSH) |
91	
92	**Cache layout:**
93	
94	```
95	~/.cache/tv/
96	├── lan-devices.tsv         # one row per device (watched by tv)
97	├── lan-ports/<ip>.txt      # nmap -sV output per host
98	├── lan-scan.log            # scan progress log
99	└── lan-scan.lock/          # mutex directory (removed on exit)
100	```
101	
102	Requires `nmap`; `rustscan` and `arp-scan` are used when present (all part of the `networking_tools` ansible role).
103	
104	---
105	
106	### `pueue` channel
107	
108	Interactive task manager for [pueue](https://github.com/Nukesor/pueue) — fuzzy-search tasks, preview logs, and pause/resume/kill/restart without leaving the picker. Parses `pueue status --json` at runtime. Requires `pueue` and `jq`.
109

```toml
# Ansible channel for television (tv)
# Browse playbooks, roles, and tags under ~/.ansible/ with inline preview and
# one-key actions for run / syntax-check / dry-run / copy-command.
#
# Usage:
#   tv ansible
#
# Source cycling (Ctrl+S):
#   1. Playbooks  (~/.ansible/playbooks/*.yml)
#   2. Roles      (~/.ansible/roles/*/)
#   3. Tags       (extracted from playbooks)
#
# Keybindings:
#   Enter      Run playbook (or run the OS-default playbook filtered by role/tag)
#   Alt+C      Syntax check
#   Alt+D      Dry run (--check)
#   Alt+T      Run OS-default playbook filtered by selected tag/role
#   Alt+E      Edit selected file in $EDITOR
#   Alt+V      Open role directory in yazi (roles only)
#   Ctrl+Y     Copy full ansible-playbook command to clipboard (overrides TV default)
#   Alt+Y      Copy full ansible-playbook command to clipboard
#   Ctrl+F     Cycle preview
#   Ctrl+O     Toggle preview panel
#
# All actions cd into ~/.ansible and export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=~/.ansible/ansible.cfg.
# OS default: macos.yml on Darwin, linux.yml otherwise.

[metadata]
name = "ansible"
description = "Ansible playbooks / roles / tags: browse, syntax-check, run, copy command"
requirements = ["ansible-playbook"]

[source]
command = [
  """find ~/.ansible/playbooks -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.yml' 2>/dev/null | sort | awk -F/ '{name=$NF; sub(/\\.yml$/,"",name); printf "playbook\\t%s\\t%s\\n", name, $0}'""",
  """find ~/.ansible/roles -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort | awk -F/ '{printf "role\\t%s\\t%s\\n", $NF, $0}'""",
  """grep -hoE 'tags: \\[[^]]+\\]' ~/.ansible/playbooks/*.yml 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/tags: \\[//; s/\\]//; s/,/\\n/g' | tr -d ' ' | sort -u | awk 'NF{printf "tag\\t%s\\t-\\n", $0}'""",
]
display = "{split:\\t:0}  {split:\\t:1}"
output = "{split:\\t:1}"
no_sort = true

[preview]
command = [
  """k='{split:\\t:0}'; n='{split:\\t:1}'; p='{split:\\t:2}'; if [ "$k" = "playbook" ]; then bat --color=always -l yaml --style=numbers "$p" 2>/dev/null || cat "$p"; elif [ "$k" = "role" ]; then m="$p/tasks/main.yml"; d="$p/defaults/main.yml"; [ -f "$m" ] && { echo '=== tasks/main.yml ==='; bat --color=always -l yaml --style=numbers "$m" 2>/dev/null || cat "$m"; }; [ -f "$d" ] && { echo; echo '=== defaults/main.yml ==='; bat --color=always -l yaml --style=numbers "$d" 2>/dev/null || cat "$d"; }; elif [ "$k" = "tag" ]; then grep -rn --color=always "tags: \\[.*${n}.*\\]" ~/.ansible/playbooks/ 2>/dev/null; fi""",
  """k='{split:\\t:0}'; n='{split:\\t:1}'; p='{split:\\t:2}'; if [ "$k" = "playbook" ]; then grep -hoE 'tags: \\[[^]]+\\]' "$p" | sed -E 's/tags: \\[//; s/\\]//; s/,/\\n/g' | tr -d ' ' | sort -u; elif [ "$k" = "role" ]; then ls -la "$p"; elif [ "$k" = "tag" ]; then grep -rln --color=always "tags: \\[.*${n}.*\\]" ~/.ansible/roles/ 2>/dev/null | head -40; fi""",
]
header = "{split:\\t:0}: {split:\\t:1}"

[ui]
input_header = "Ansible"

[ui.preview_panel]
size = 55

[keybindings]
enter = "actions:run"
alt-c = "actions:syntax_check"
alt-d = "actions:check"
alt-t = "actions:run_tag"
alt-e = "actions:edit"
alt-v = "actions:yazi"
ctrl-y = "actions:copy_cmd"
alt-y = "actions:copy_cmd"

[actions.run]
description = "Run playbook (or OS-default playbook filtered by role/tag)"
command = """k='{split:\\t:0}'; n='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; cd ~/.ansible || exit 1; export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg; if [ "$k" = "playbook" ]; then ansible-playbook "playbooks/${n}.yml"; else ansible-playbook "playbooks/${pb}" --tags "$n"; fi; echo; echo '[Press Enter to exit]'; read -r _"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.syntax_check]
description = "Syntax check"
command = """k='{split:\\t:0}'; n='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; cd ~/.ansible || exit 1; export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg; if [ "$k" = "playbook" ]; then ansible-playbook --syntax-check "playbooks/${n}.yml"; else ansible-playbook --syntax-check "playbooks/${pb}" --tags "$n"; fi; echo; echo '[Press Enter to exit]'; read -r _"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.check]
description = "Dry run (--check)"
command = """k='{split:\\t:0}'; n='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; cd ~/.ansible || exit 1; export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg; if [ "$k" = "playbook" ]; then ansible-playbook --check "playbooks/${n}.yml"; else ansible-playbook --check "playbooks/${pb}" --tags "$n"; fi; echo; echo '[Press Enter to exit]'; read -r _"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.run_tag]
description = "Run OS-default playbook filtered by selected tag/role name"
command = """n='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; cd ~/.ansible || exit 1; export ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg; ansible-playbook "playbooks/${pb}" --tags "$n"; echo; echo '[Press Enter to exit]'; read -r _"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.edit]
description = "Edit selected file (playbook YAML or role's tasks/main.yml)"
command = """k='{split:\\t:0}'; p='{split:\\t:2}'; if [ "$k" = "playbook" ]; then ${EDITOR:-vi} "$p"; elif [ "$k" = "role" ]; then ${EDITOR:-vi} "$p/tasks/main.yml"; else ${EDITOR:-vi} ~/.ansible/playbooks; fi"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.yazi]
description = "Open role directory in yazi"
command = """k='{split:\\t:0}'; p='{split:\\t:2}'; if [ "$k" = "role" ] && command -v yazi >/dev/null 2>&1; then yazi "$p"; else echo 'yazi action only valid on roles'; sleep 1; fi"""
mode = "execute"

[actions.copy_cmd]
description = "Copy full ansible-playbook command to clipboard"
command = """_clip() { local d; d=$(cat); [ -z "$d" ] && return; if command -v pbcopy >/dev/null; then printf '%s' "$d" | pbcopy; elif command -v wl-copy >/dev/null; then printf '%s' "$d" | wl-copy; elif command -v xclip >/dev/null; then printf '%s' "$d" | xclip -selection clipboard; else printf '%b' "\\033]52;c;$(printf '%s' "$d" | base64)\\007" > /dev/tty; fi; }; k='{split:\\t:0}'; n='{split:\\t:1}'; os=$(uname); [ "$os" = "Darwin" ] && pb=macos.yml || pb=linux.yml; if [ "$k" = "playbook" ]; then printf 'cd ~/.ansible && ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook playbooks/%s.yml' "$n" | _clip; else printf 'cd ~/.ansible && ANSIBLE_CONFIG=$HOME/.ansible/ansible.cfg ansible-playbook playbooks/%s --tags %s' "$pb" "$n" | _clip; fi"""
mode = "fork"

```

```sh
#!/bin/sh
# Preview script for the `ansible` tv channel.
# Usage: ansible-preview.sh <view> <kind> <name> <path>
#   view: main | alt
#   kind: playbook | role | tag

view="$1"
kind="$2"
name="$3"
path="$4"

show_yaml() {
  f="$1"
  if command -v bat >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    bat --color=always --paging=never -l yaml --style=numbers "$f"
  else
    cat "$f"
  fi
}

case "$view:$kind" in
  main:playbook)
    show_yaml "$path"
    ;;
  alt:playbook)
    grep -hoE 'tags: \[[^]]+\]' "$path" \
      | sed -E 's/tags: \[//; s/\]//; s/,/\n/g' \
      | tr -d ' ' | sort -u
    ;;
  main:role)
    main="$path/tasks/main.yml"
    defs="$path/defaults/main.yml"
    if [ -f "$main" ]; then
      echo "=== tasks/main.yml ==="
      show_yaml "$main"
    fi
    if [ -f "$defs" ]; then
      echo
      echo "=== defaults/main.yml ==="
      show_yaml "$defs"
    fi
    ;;
  alt:role)
    ls -la "$path"
    ;;
  main:tag)
    grep -rn --color=always "tags: \[.*${name}.*\]" "$HOME/.ansible/playbooks/" 2>/dev/null
    ;;
  alt:tag)
    grep -rln "tags: \[.*${name}.*\]" "$HOME/.ansible/roles/" 2>/dev/null | head -40
    ;;
esac

```
